subject: Range 14 Closure for Scheduled Maintenance
addressees: Commander, 1st Battalion, 5th Infantry Regiment, 1234 Warrior Way, Fort Carson, CO  80913-4321
Commander, 2d Battalion, 5th Infantry Regiment, 1236 Warrior Way, Fort Carson, CO  80913-4321

paragraphs.text: Range 14 closes for scheduled surface danger zone maintenance from 3 August 2026 through 7 August 2026.  Reschedule all live-fire iterations before 25 July 2026.
Range Control will complete the following work during the closure:
Replace the target lifters on lanes 1 through 12.
Regrade the access road and repair the berm on the north impact area.

Units holding reservations on the affected dates will submit a revised range request through the Range Facility Management Support System no later than 1500 on 25 July 2026.  Range Control will confirm each new reservation within two duty days.
My point of contact for this action is Mr. David Okonkwo, ATZB-RC, at 719-555-0142 or david.a.okonkwo.civ@army.mil.
